_comment: Seed scoring config. Tune on the device at /sdcard/Pillion/config/scoring.json and press Reload config. Formula is specified in docs/BUILD_SPEC.md section 5 - implement it exactly, then tune here. Tuning knobs for common symptoms are in docs/RISKS_AND_FALLBACKS.md section 4.

benchmarkRupeesPerKm._comment: Market rate per EFFECTIVE km (trip + pickup) that a score of ~1.0 on the rate term represents. Seeded from rough Pune two-wheeler/auto economics - treat as a starting point and tune against how the demo feels, not as ground truth.

_speedComment: Pune city average including traffic. Used only when the notification carries no ETA.
_deadheadComment: If pickupKm / effectiveKm exceeds deadheadWarnShare, subtract deadheadPenalty from the raw score and add ReasonCode.LONG_DEADHEAD. Corpus payload U3 (6.5 km pickup for a 4.0 km trip, share 0.62) must trigger this.
_arbitrationComment: A live rival offer must beat this offer's score by this factor before we say BEATEN_BY_OTHER_OFFER. Lower it if arbitration never fires; raise it if it fires on near-ties and looks arbitrary on stage.
_weightsComment: Weights sum to ~2.2, and score = clamp(raw * 50, 0, 100), so a market-rate offer in a neutral zone with the driver on-target lands around 55-65. Change wRate last - it is the load-bearing term.
_ewmaComment: threshold = clamp(midpoint(acceptedEwma, rejectedEwma)). Raise ewmaAlpha to 0.4 if the threshold bar does not visibly move during the stage demo - the demo moment matters more than statistical elegance.

zones._comment: Static Pune zone demand, 0.0 (dead - you will deadhead back) to 1.0 (hot). Matched case-insensitively as a substring of the drop text. An unmatched zone scores neutralZoneDemand. This is domain judgement, not measured data - say so if a judge asks, and say that the next version learns it from the driver's own history.
